text:
Riley Park: Heads-up — customer reported duplicate order records when using the Node onboarding sample. Repro was: token refresh triggered while POSTing /v1/orders, upstream 429, SDK retried and created two orders.

Nina Patel: Which SDK version and sample app?

Riley Park: node-sdk v1.3.0, sample-app v0.4. The sample sets `Idempotency-Key` on the request but the header disappears on the retry that happens during auth.refresh.

Omar Reyes: oh no. Is this the same auth middleware that does auto-retry after refreshing creds? I thought we preserved custom headers.

Riley Park: middleware is doing replays by reconstructing the request and it accidentally filters out headers not in a whitelist. We whitelist auth headers but not user-supplied ones like Idempotency-Key.

Chris Nguyen: quick mitigation: whitelist `Idempotency-Key` and any `X-` prefixed headers by default, and add an explicit pass-through option in SDK config.

Nina Patel: agree. Also recommend adding a short-lived client-side replay cache keyed by (method,path,body) + idempotency header fallback so if a retry happens within 20s we dedupe locally.

Riley Park: sketch of policy: if POST and no Idempotency-Key, generate client-replay-id and store hash for 20s. If server indicates success but we think it may be duplicated, consult server's eventual-duplicate detection header (if present) OR emit telemetry `client-replay-detected`.

Omar Reyes: backoff tweak: replace our linear jitter with full jitter per AWS best practices for 429s. Suggested algorithm:
```
backoff = min(base * 2^attempt, max)
sleep = random(0, backoff)
base=200ms, max=5s
```

Chris Nguyen: add config flags: { strictMode: boolean, replayWindowMs: number, preserveUserHeaders: string[] } and default strictMode=false. In strictMode, refuse to retry POSTs without explicit Idempotency-Key.

Nina Patel: QA: add unit test that simulates token refresh race + 429 and asserts single POST received by mocked backend. Also add flaky/integration test that runs sample-app under network partition for both node & go SDKs.

Riley Park: I'll open a PR with small middleware change + tests. Will include telemetry event `sdk.replay.missing_idempotency` and `sdk.replay.deduped_local`.

devex-bot: Ticket DEX-4101 created: "node-sdk: preserve idempotency header across auth retries + client-side replay cache" — https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-4101 :white_check_mark:

Chris Nguyen: docs update too: onboarding quickstart should explicitly show how to set Idempotency-Key and explain strictMode. Add a short FAQ entry about when SDK will synthesize a replay id.

qa-bot: Note for QA run: include a matrix test (node v16/18, go v1.20, python 3.11) and enable telemetry capture.

Nina Patel: follow-up: check streaming resume path as well — the same header-drop bug could apply when resuming a stream after reconnect. If so, add DEX-4102.

Riley Park: added DEX-4102 for streaming resume parity checks. Will ping on PR.

Omar Reyes: one more thought: server-side we can accept duplicate create attempts if Idempotency-Key is present — but our customers rely on SDK doing the right thing. Prioritize the SDK fix.

Riley Park: agreed. PR incoming in the next few hours.
